an2.3:1.4: has done bad things by way of speech, and not done good things by way of speech;
an2.3:1.5: has done bad things by way of mind, and not done good things by way of mind.
an2.3:1.7: Thinking, ‘I’ve done bad things by way of speech’, they’re mortified; thinking, ‘I haven’t done good things by way of speech’, they’re mortified;
an2.3:1.8: Thinking, ‘I’ve done bad things by way of mind’, they’re mortified; thinking, ‘I haven’t done good things by way of mind’, they’re mortified.
